When she takes the reins in January, Democratic Governor-elect Amy Acton has to begin work on her 2028-2029 executive budget proposal almost immediately. [...] After the inauguration, Acton has just two months to get her ideas on how Ohio will or won’t fund various agencies and services to members of the Ohio General Assembly.
